title: Daily digest: '90 seats, one crore votes': Revanth Red | Wanted man held after 14 months for mob  | Tilak’s 100 in vain as Pakistan A beat I
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Times of India / The Hindu / Indian Express
bullets_en: '90 seats, one crore votes': Revanth Reddy sets Congress' 2028 Telangana target.
Wanted man held after 14 months for mob attack on Delhi police team in Chhatarpur.
Tilak’s 100 in vain as Pakistan A beat India A in Rising Stars Asia Cup.
bullets_ur: '90 seats, ek crore vote': Revanth Reddy ne Congress ke liye 2028 Telangana ka hadaf muqarrar kar diya.
Chhatarpur mein Delhi police team par mob attack ke 14 mahinay baad wanted shakhs giraftar.
Tilak ki 100 runs ki inings raigaan gayi, Pakistan A ne Rising Stars Asia Cup mein India A ko shikast de di.
